data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Qanī' which means 'strong, firm, steadfast, or solid'. This name carries a powerful and unyielding spirit. The name Kani carries the meaning “Strong, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kani usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
